result.reason: The clause provides the fallback 90-day transition period at then-current rates, but it does not require data export within 30 days or specify a standard machine-readable format. “Thereafter return or certifiably destroy” is ambiguous as to timing and does not clearly require certification of deletion. It also unnecessarily expands the existing deliverables obligation to all Works, source code, documentation, and credentials, potentially altering unrelated ownership and delivery rights beyond what the transition rule requires.
